question: How much premium did we do in 2025?
final_text:
Gross written premium booked in 2025 was **£30,274,839.20**. This is net of cancellations and includes new business, renewals and mid-term adjustments (MTAs).

| Transaction type | 2025 written premium (£) |
|---|---|
| New business | 13,916,006.79 |
| Renewals | 17,264,002.22 |
| MTAs | 106,173.07 |
| Cancellations | −1,011,342.88 |
| **Total** | **30,274,839.20** |

"Premium we did" could also mean earned premium. I took it to mean written premium, using the booked date. Grouping by effective date instead gives a slightly different total.

ANSWER: 30274839.20

input.query: select txn_type, count(*), sum(written_premium), sum(case when year(booked_date)=2025 then written_premium end) w_booked, sum(case when year(effective_date)=2025 then written_premium end) w_eff from premium_txn group by 1
